title: Push step-count axis further: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^18 -> 2^17
description: Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum_steps=1), doubling optimizer steps again within the fixed 5-min budget on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96, DEPTH=8, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 baseline.
reflection: Clear win: val_bpb 0.978120 vs baseline 0.982306, a ~0.43% improvement well outside the ~0.02-0.03% noise band this cell has repeatedly shown. This extrapolates the strongest confirmed lever in the log (step-count via TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE) one step further in its winning direction, and it had never actually been run despite being proposed in round 3 (everyone pivoted away then). Worth testing 2^16 next to see if the trend continues or plateaus/reverses, though VRAM/step-time headroom should be checked (peak_vram_mb was 33.2GB here, well within budget, so smaller batch isn't the constraint).
